g.text: Figure 4a — UML Class diagram — project-owned application contracts
Concrete record type is the discriminant.
UML Class diagram: application-owned contracts are the stable pivot across hexagonal adapters.
Authentication state is a sealed project-owned OperatorContext; Spring Security types stop at
adapters. CustomerReviewQuery/Page and AnalysisHistoryQuery/Page bound operator-facing
review without changing the complete CustomerSnapshot used by analysis. Source truth remains
the complete CustomerSnapshot/RiskEvidence graph for Stage 1/2. AnalysisEvidenceEnvelope is a
distinct model-facing projection: exact full-history counts remain truthful while only
deterministically selected details cross AnalysisModelPort. Detector evidence, retrieval evidence
and model/backend provenance share a sealed typed artifact family without sharing authority.
Persistence relations and provider/framework response types do not become members of this
